units.title: Counting by weighing
units: A sealed bag of nickels on the bank's scale.
First, zero the scale with the empty bag. Now it reads the coins alone.
The scale reads 1,250.0 g. How many nickels?
1,250.0 g ÷ 5.000 g per nickel. The grams cancel.
If every object has the same mass, divide the total by one object's mass. The grams cancel. A pure number is left.
A roll of nickels has a mass of 200.0 g. How many nickels is that?
A. 200.0 g ÷ 5.000 g per nickel = 40 nickels.

units.title: The mole
units: A baker counts eggs by the dozen: 12.
Atoms are tiny. How big must the chemist's counting unit be?
One mole: 6.022 × 10 23 particles. The symbol is mol.
Since May 20, 2019: exactly 6.02214076 × 10 23 . We round it to 6.022 × 10 23 .
Avogadro's number has no unit. The Avogadro constant is the same number per mole: 6.022 × 10 23 mol −1 .
One mole contains exactly 6.02214076 × 10 23 particles. In calculations we round it to 6.022 × 10 23 . A mole is a count, not a mass.
A count of particles: 6.022 × 10 23 of them
B mass of a substance in grams
A. Like a dozen, a mole is a number of things. A very large one.

units.title: How many is a mole?
units: A dozen: 12. You can count them.

Every step is 1,000 times more. Watch the counter.

One mole of water molecules has a mass of about…

A. Avogadro's number is huge because molecules are tiny.

Same number of atoms. Different mass.

1 mol of O 2 molecules holds twice the atoms of 1 mol of O atoms.
Name the particle every time: atoms, molecules, formula units or ions.
Always name the particle. It can be atoms, molecules, formula units or ions.
One mole of aluminum and one mole of copper…
A hold equal numbers of atoms, different masses
C hold different numbers; copper atoms are larger
A. Same count; copper atoms have more mass.

units.title: Who found the number
units: 1811: Avogadro's idea. Equal gas volumes hold equal numbers of particles. He never knew the number.
1865: Loschmidt made the first estimate of the size of molecules.
1890s: Ostwald made the word Mol a unit.
1909: Jean Perrin measured it several ways and named it after Avogadro. Nobel Prize, 1926.
1971: the mole became an SI base unit. Old definition: the atoms in exactly 12 g of carbon-12.
Predict: today, is the number measured, or fixed by definition?
Voted November 16, 2018. Exact since May 20, 2019. No longer measured.
Since May 20, 2019 the number is exact: 6.02214076 × 10 23 . It is no longer measured.

units.title: Counting the atoms in a silicon sphere
units: Counting the atoms in a silicon sphere
The Avogadro project: a nearly perfect sphere of silicon.
How could anyone count the atoms in this ball?
The sphere is one crystal. Its atoms repeat in identical cubes.
X-rays measure one cube's edge: 543.102 pm. Each cube holds 8 atoms.
The density gives the mass of one cube, so of one atom.
Mass of one mole of silicon ÷ mass of one atom = 6.022 × 10 23 .
The atoms of a crystal repeat in identical cubes. Count one cube and measure its size. Then the whole sphere is counted.
In the Avogadro project, a silicon sphere was used to…
A count its atoms: mass, density, atom spacing
B define the kilogram by its size
C compare silicon and carbon atoms
A. They gave the value fixed in 2019.

units: Moles on the left. Particles on the right. The bridge is 6.022 × 10 23 per mole.

units.title: Particles to moles

units.title: Formula units
units: Sodium chloride is a crystal of ions. It has no molecules.
One formula unit: one Na + and one Cl − .
4.50 mol of NaCl makes 2.71 × 10 24 of what?
"1.51 × 10 24 molecules of NaCl": right number, wrong particle.
Count a metal in atoms. Count a molecular compound in molecules. Count an ionic compound in formula units.
Which particles are counted in 1 mol of NaCl?
A formula units: one Na + and one Cl − each
C sodium atoms and chlorine atoms
A. NaCl has no molecules. Its formula gives the ratio of ions.

units.title: Atoms in a molecule
units: Atom colors show the element, not the charge.
One water molecule: two H atoms, one O atom. The subscript says so.
One mole of water molecules. How many moles of hydrogen atoms?
1 mol of H 2 O holds 2 mol of H atoms and 1 mol of O atoms.
2.00 mol of CO 2 × 2 = 4.00 mol of O atoms.
1 mol of NaCl holds 1 mol of Na + ions and 1 mol of Cl − ions.
Moles of an element's atoms = moles of molecules × its subscript. Then multiply by 6.022 × 10 23 to count the atoms.
How many moles of oxygen atoms are in 2.0 mol of carbon dioxide, CO 2 ?
A. Each CO 2 molecule has two oxygen atoms: 2.0 mol × 2.
